observations.result: Diagnostic-only disposable Git fixtures reproduce approved schema completion refusal and inherited tracked mutation false acceptance. These are not product QA.

Suite command executes Python assertions with exact process exits; scope command unions committed, index, worktree and untracked projections with rename detection disabled and exact assigned record families. No grep, output pipeline or self-derived expected result is used.

Acceptance requires added suite cases to assert the enumerated F1/F2 controls. The suite command alone is not a passing implementation claim; test quality and all case assertions will be independently inspected after code is written.

final_verdict.summary: Revision 2 provides bounded source scope and testable F1/F2 authorization, endpoint identity, multi-layer scope and legacy behaviors; no blocking testability defects found.
